explication: pgAdmin 4 is a PostgreSQL administration web application, deployable in a browser or as a standalone Electron desktop app. Its core workflow is to authenticate a user, browse and connect to PostgreSQL servers, then inspect or manage database objects and run SQL through the Query Tool. The README documents the Flask server/client architecture and Electron’s server-launch role; sampled source confirms Query Tool connection handling, driver connections, dashboards, file management, and report-pipeline stages. Several major feature branches are documented by the tree but their internal wiring was not sampled.
